name: WebTrendSEO Structured Data Editor
author: adeelakramseo

sections.description:
Structured Data Editor Free adds a visual schema panel to the block editor. Create WebPage, Article, BlogPosting, AboutPage, ContactPage, Person and Organization nodes. Set values manually or resolve standard WordPress and supported SEO values automatically. Preview the resolved JSON-LD, review warnings and save with the page.

Included Free functionality works without a license, account or time limit. Page export and site backup/restore are included. Stored templates, entities and advanced documents remain readable for compatible output and backup recovery; their management and advanced editing interfaces are supplied separately in Pro and are absent from this directory package. JSON-LD rendering is not license-gated.

Pro is distributed separately through Freemius. It provides reusable-template and entity editors, advanced binding controls, a Global Values editor, site-wide Health reports and a custom JSON editing workspace.

Existing 0.9.5 clients: install and activate the protected Pro migration package before changing to the directory edition if you need to keep all your previous editing interfaces. Your legacy entitlement, schemas, templates, entities, source bindings, settings and IDs are preserved. Do not uninstall the existing plugin or rename its folders.

Compatibility is verified for Yoast SEO 28.5 Free, Rank Math 1.0.280 Free and AIOSEO 5.0.3 Free, one active at a time. Coexist is the default; Exclusive suppresses those supported SEO plugins’ schema. Other schema producers require separate review. WooCommerce schema, multisite and paid SEO editions are not covered by the release verification.

Valid structured data does not guarantee a Google rich result or a ranking improvement. Markup must match the content users can see.

Guide: https://webtrendseo.com/schema-studio-guide/
Support: contact@webtrendseo.com

External services

The plugin includes the Freemius WordPress SDK for optional account connection, usage analytics, support and upgrading to the separate Pro product. Basic schema editing, validation, rendering and backup do not require connecting. The SDK asks for permission before optional data collection. When you choose to connect, it sends account and installation details such as administrator email/name, site URL, WordPress/PHP/plugin versions and license/account information to Freemius. Optional diagnostic/extensions data is controlled by the SDK permission choices. Licensing, checkout and support actions communicate with Freemius when explicitly used.
Service: https://freemius.com/
Privacy: https://freemius.com/privacy/
Terms: https://freemius.com/terms/
The local Schema.org vocabulary and scripts are bundled. Preview and validation run locally; schema documents are not sent to a remote validation service. Following the guide link opens webtrendseo.com in your browser.
sections.installation:
1. Back up any existing Structured Data Editor installation. Existing clients needing advanced editing should migrate to the protected Pro package first.
  2. Deactivate any active WebTrendSEO schema edition manually on the Plugins screen. Upload the Free ZIP in Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin, then activate it.
  3. Skip optional account connection if you do not want it.
  4. Open Structured Data Editor > Global settings and review the site identity and stable ID.
  5. Edit a page in the block editor, open the Structured Data Editor document panel and enable schema.
  6. Add nodes and properties. Use Preview & validate, then update or publish the page.
  7. Review public output. Use Structured Data Editor > Backup & Transfer before major changes.
sections.faq:
Do I need an account or license for Free?

No. All functionality included in this package is available without either.

Will switching editions delete my data?

No. Edition changes do not uninstall or delete plugin data. The directory edition has different editing interfaces, so existing clients should use the protected Pro migration package to retain advanced editing functionality. Keep a backup.

Does uninstall delete schemas?

No automatic data deletion routine is included. Export your backup before removing the plugin.

What does Exclusive mode cover?

Supported Yoast, Rank Math and AIOSEO schema filters. It does not promise suppression of every theme, widget or other plugin.
